rows.note: Use 傍晚 as the all-purpose noun for the transition from late afternoon into evening.

example.english: We go for dim sum in the evening.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 bong6 maan5 heoi3 jam2 caa4

rows.note: Use 夜晚 for the later, darker part of the evening, shading into nighttime.

example.english: It's raining so heavily in the evening that I don't want to go out.
example.traditional: 夜晚落咁大雨，我唔想出街。
example.jyutping: je6 maan5 lok6 gam3 daai6 jyu5 ngo5 m4 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1
